**On the Galois action on motivic fundamental groups of punctured elliptic and rational curves**

123 pp, 40 sections.

**Abstract.** On the Galois Action on Motivic Fundamental Groups of Punctured Elliptic and Rational Curves Nikolay Malkin 2021 The main motive of this thesis is to study the action of the motivic Galois group on the motivic fundamental group of an algebraic curve 푋punctured at a ﬁnite set of points 푆: GalMot ⟳휋Mot 1 (푋−푆, 푣0). (1) The algebraic, geometric, and analytic aspects of this action are examined in two cases: for 푋= P1 and for 푋 an elliptic curve. To study this action, we rely on motivic correlators, canonical elements in the fundamental Lie coalgebra of the category of mixed motives over a number ﬁeld. We trace three themes: (1) The Lie coalgebra structure on the motivic correlators. Using combinatorial arguments with an injection of Hodge theory, we ﬁnd general families of relations (double shuﬄe relations) on these elements. (2) The Hodge realization of the structure in (1).
